current_prompt.body:
EXECUTE the First Fit algorithm on a bin packing problem with bin capacity 10 and items [5, 5, 5, 3, 3, 3, 7, 7] in the given arrival order.
REPORT the resulting packing from the First Fit algorithm.
DETERMINE an optimal packing that minimizes the number of bins for the same items and capacity.
REPORT the optimal packing.
COMPUTE the gap between the First Fit solution and the optimal solution (difference in number of bins).
EXPLAIN why the arrival order causes the First Fit algorithm to use more bins.
INCLUDE a self‑test that verifies both packings use each item exactly once and that no bin exceeds the capacity constraint.

current_plan.body:
APPLY the First Fit algorithm to the item sequence with bin capacity 10 and RECORD the resulting bin assignments.
EMIT the First Fit packing.
DETERMINE an optimal bin packing for the same items and capacity and RECORD the packing.
EMIT the optimal packing.
COMPARE the number of bins used in the First Fit packing with the number in the optimal packing and COMPUTE the gap (difference in bin count).
EMIT the gap.

EMIT the explanation.
BUILD a self‑test that VALIDATES that each packing uses each item exactly once and that no bin exceeds capacity 10.

EMIT the self‑test result.
